headline: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said on Wednesday that Saudi Arabia has extended its additional $3 billion deposit for Pakistan for a 'reasonable period', Arab News reports.

card.desc: Riyadh ka $5 billion deposit pehle hi 2028 tak barhaya ja chuka.

caption:
Saudi Arabia ne $3 billion ka deposit aage barha diya!
Arab News ke mutabiq Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb ne Wednesday ko bataya ke Saudi Arabia ne Pakistan ke liye $3 billion ki izafi support ki muddat "reasonable period" ke liye barha di hai. Riyadh ka $5 billion ka deposit pehle hi 2028 tak roll over ho chuka hai.
